key_points: CVS extended its pact with McKesson, signaling continued supply partnership.
A distribution deal extension highlighted as potentially a big deal for CVS.
Aetna's 2027 Medicare plans will offer $0 copays for in-network colonoscopies and mammograms, likely boosting preventive service utilization.
Institutional investor Argent Capital Management acquired CVS shares, indicating buying interest.
Wall Street Zen downgraded CVS to Buy (still positive but less bullish), while CX Institutional sold shares, showing mixed institutional sentiment.
